Container.Name: Phlexerr
Container.Overview: Review Plex movies and TV shows as deletion candidates (IMDb rating, date added, last viewed, % viewed, requested by, plays in the past year, size) and bulk-delete them, optionally also removing them from Radarr, Sonarr and Seerr. Starts in dry-run mode.

Config.Name: Config / data
Config.Description: Stores the report cache, keep-list and deletion log

Config.Name: App password
Config.Description: Password for signing in. Default is obiwan so you can get started quickly: CHANGE IT before exposing this to anyone else.

Config.Name: DRY_RUN
Config.Description: true = nothing is ever deleted, you only get a report of what would happen. Set to false to enable real deletion.

Config.Name: Plex URL
Config.Description: e.g. http://SERVER-IP:32400 (optional here: you can also enter it in the web UI Settings page)

Config.Name: Plex token
Config.Description: Optional here (or use the web UI Settings page). X-Plex-Token. Plex web app > any item > ... > Get Info > View XML > copy X-Plex-Token from the URL

Config.Name: Tautulli API key
Config.Description: Tautulli > Settings > Web Interface > API key

Config.Name: MDBList API key (optional)
Config.Description: Only needed for MDBList lists that are not public (mdblist.com/preferences)

Config.Name: Plex link base (optional)
Config.Description: Where title/poster links open. Blank = https://app.plex.tv/desktop. Can also be set in Settings.

Config.Name: Plex libraries (optional)
Config.Description: Comma-separated library names to include. Blank = all movie and TV libraries.

Config.Name: Secure cookie (HTTPS)
Config.Description: Set true when reached over HTTPS, e.g. through a Cloudflare tunnel

Config.Name: Trust proxy headers
Config.Description: Set true behind Cloudflare/reverse proxy so the real client IP is used for login throttling
